name: maqami-travel
description: Official MCP server for MAQAMI, a hotel and flight booking platform with 3M+ hotels. Search hotels and flights, read hotel details and reviews, then prebook and book a chosen offer. Booking creates a real reservation, so the agent should confirm with the user first.

http.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint. No account or API key needed.

npm.description: Local stdio bridge to the hosted endpoint

examples.title: Hotel search
examples.description: Find hotels with live rates for given dates and guests
examples.prompt: Find 4-star hotels in Lisbon for 2 adults from 12 to 15 May.

examples.title: Hotel details and reviews
examples.description: Read a hotel's description, amenities and guest reviews
examples.prompt: Show the amenities and recent guest reviews for the second hotel.

examples.title: Flight search
examples.prompt: Search flights from Dubai to London on 10 December for one adult.

examples.title: Prebook before booking
examples.description: Confirm the final price and availability before any booking
examples.prompt: Prebook that room and tell me the final price and cancellation terms before I decide.
